findings.title: The active sysid experiment is the one learner that ignores the learning freeze, and contaminated nights get adopted
findings.claim: coordinator._run_system_identification aborts only on pump freeze_reason/space_blocked and never consults _learning_frozen, so the experiment records samples through external heat, defrost, an open window and a pinned indoor reading (4 of 4 contaminations ingested, against 0 of 4 for the house heat-loss learner), and 4 of 12 contaminated experiment nights on the three presets are then adopted by the #1410 gate and persisted.
findings.mechanism: Every passive learner calls _learning_frozen(...) (external heat, pump freeze, defrosting, unusable input, ventilation). _run_system_identification (coordinator.py:10431) checks only self._pump_signals.space_blocked and .freeze_reason, then calls SystemIdentification.step with the pinned room reading and the commanded power. The experiment's result seeds _house_heat_loss_scale via _adopt_system_identification and is saved immediately, so it is the learner with the largest single-step write.

findings.consequence_detail: s1_sysid_contam.py: clean fit error 0.000 % on all presets; admitted contaminated cells: heavy_old wood -2.90 % / defrost +6.47 %, typical_slab wood -1.35 % / defrost +3.14 % adopted-UA error (fit errors -4.6..+9.7 %); window and stale cells are refused only because their interval came out inf. The gross ones are caught; the mid-sized ones are persisted with samples=int(20*weight).

findings.title: The one-room sysid plant cannot run on a two-zone house: 0 of 3 two-zone presets adopt, 2 abort past the comfort bound
findings.claim: The experiment's sizer (sysid._sizing_model) and fit (sysid._simulate_slab_path) hard-code two_zone_enabled=False while the coordinator feeds it the upper-zone thermometer, so on the three stress presets derived two-zone the experiment adopts nothing (0 of 3: light_new and typical_slab abort in the step phase at 0.83 K and 0.91 K sensor excursion against the 0.8 K allowance, heavy_old finishes with a -5.66 % UA and an infinite interval), against 2 of 3 adopted on the same presets single-zone.
findings.mechanism: sysid.py:127 and :508 build a single-zone ThermalModel; coordinator._update_current_state writes the indoor reading to room_temperature and upper_floor_temperature, and _run_system_identification sizes on params.room_thermal_mass / heat_loss_coefficient. The two-zone upper floor (radiator share, smaller mass) responds faster than the one-room model predicts, so the sized step overshoots the allowance and the abort fires after the room already passed it.

findings.title: The #1410 adoption gate refuses silently: a refused fit stays published as completed, reason ok, with its UA
findings.claim: _adopt_system_identification's first guard returns without writing a reason or a log line, so 10 of 19 finished experiments across the three presets are refused while SystemIdentification.as_dict() (the learning view's system_identification attribute) keeps publishing completed=True, reason='ok' and the fitted heat_loss_kw_per_c (e.g. heavy_old open-window night: 0.5328 kW/K, +72 %), contradicting identify_slab's docstring that such a window is 'refused by name'.
findings.mechanism: coordinator.py:10495-10496 `if not result.completed or hw is None or hw > UA_ADOPTION_HALFWIDTH_BAR: return`. Only the identifiability branch below it writes replace(result, completed=False, reason=why); an adopted result is rewritten to reason='adopted'. The interval refusal leaves the result untouched and logs nothing.

evidence.unit: finished experiments refused by the gate yet published completed=True reason='ok' (of 19)
evidence.machine: 4-vCPU cloud container (x86_64, 15 GB), shared with ~13 seats

perturbation.change: --perturb-fix: the one-line production edit (the guard writes replace(result, completed=False, reason='ua interval too wide') before returning), applied in memory from the method's own source and restored in finally; --perturb-bar (config-level: coordinator.UA_ADOPTION_HALFWIDTH_BAR=1e9) is the weaker secondary arm

findings.metric_definition: Count of finished experiments where the production gate wrote no scale and as_dict()['result'] still reads completed=True and reason=='ok' after the gate ran.
findings.phenomenon_property: Every refusal of a finished experiment must publish a named reason and leave the result not-completed, as the identifiability refusal and the adoption path already do.

null_control.value: adopted cells (9 of 19) publish completed=False reason='adopted' and emit 1 log line each; refused cells emit 0
null_control.note: the adoption arm is observable; only the refusal arm is silent

findings.leave_one_out_note: per preset: light_new 5/5 silent, heavy_old 2/7, typical_slab 3/7; with light_new (the most favourable preset) dropped, 5 of 14 remain silent
findings.proposed_fix_scope: coordinator._adopt_system_identification: on the interval refusal, write replace(result, completed=False, reason=<named>) and log at INFO, mirroring the identifiability refusal two lines below. One method.

non_findings.claim: Step 2: on the matched plant the production two-state fit (identify_slab) recovers UA exactly on all three presets; the adoption gate admits heavy_old (hw 0.0300) and typical_slab (hw 0.0531) and refuses light_new by its prior half-width (0.1446 > bar 0.0953) even on a noise-free perfect fit.
Step 2: the one-state identify() (harness-only path, arm without a plant) refuses the two-state plant on all three presets rather than adopting a biased UA.
non_findings.value: light_new 'fitted parameters outside plausible bounds', heavy_old 'fitted gains outside plausible bounds', typical_slab 'fit gave implausible signs'

non_findings.claim: Step 2: a free four-constant two-state fit (the two-exponential comparison) started 2x off on C_r, C_s, k_s recovers UA on light_new; heavy_old/typical_slab not run (minutes per preset under load; --free).

Step 2: the adoption gate holds under slab-pair misdeclaration (true k_s or C_s x0.5/0.7/1.4/2.0 vs the configured pair the fit trusts): no fit with |UA bias| > 10 % is admitted; the biased ones come out with an infinite interval and are refused. Perturbation --perturb-declared (declare the true pair) collapses every bias to 0.00 %.
non_findings.value: admitted_biased_cells=0 of 15 completed (18 cells); max |bias| 25.83 %, 14.93 % with the worst dropped; admitted max |adopted err| 2.53 %

non_findings.claim: Step 3: the passive learners that read the contaminated signals freeze on them: house heat loss freezes on external heat, defrost, pump fault/offline, ventilation, stale indoor; measured COP, flow-lift fold and buffer cooling freeze on all plant-wide reasons and correctly ignore a stale INDOOR reading (not their key). Away gates only the comfort learner, which is correct for the physics learners.
non_findings.value: house_heat_loss contaminated_ingest=0/4; measured_cop, flow_lift_fold, buffer_cooling 1/4 (indoor_stale only, not their input); all clean=1

non_findings.claim: Step 3 (observation, not a finding): measured COP, flow-lift fold and buffer cooling also freeze on ventilation and external heat, which do not touch their signal; this is the documented fail-closed trade in _learning_frozen's docstring (lost convergence, never corruption).
non_findings.value: ventilation and external_heat columns = 0 for those three

non_findings.claim: Step 4: last_buffer_trajectory is gone; the objective and the terminal cost are pure functions of their arguments: evaluating another plan, or a whole second optimize() with a different initial tank on the same optimizer, between two evaluations changes nothing, one objective evaluation writes no instance attribute, and no horizon-length series is left on the model/optimizer. The instrument moves: --perturb (re-introducing a model-held buffer series read by the terminal closure) gives tc_order_mismatch 1, scratch_attrs 1, side_series 1.

Step 4 hygiene note (below the finding bar, D5 territory): optimizer.py:1040-1041 still says 'the model stashes the series on itself for the terminal-cost term', which s1_statefulness.py shows is no longer true (side_series=0).
